name: Dimensional lumber board
summary: Dimensional lumber board, default 2 ft 2x4: eased arrises, sawn end grain, grade stamp, angled ends, grain-continuous crosscut and rip helpers.
parts: planed kiln-dried SPF 2x4 body, 38 x 89 mm dressed, grain along the length
3 mm factory round-over on the four long arrises
fresh sawn end-grain caps with growth rings around an off-center pith
faint inked grade stamp (SPF No.2 S-DRY KD) on the top face
style: Fresh lumberyard stud cut to a 2 ft length: clean pale pine, occasional knot, crisp sawn ends.
notes: Size is the default 2x4 (x length, y thickness, z width). Game builds every board and cut piece from this struct.
